_doc: cockpit settings. Your own JSON (userConfig 'config', else ~/.claude/effort-board/cockpit.config.json) is deep-merged over this file; keys starting with _ are ignored. Prices, thresholds and screen labels of the detail views are factory's (lib/factory/factory.config.json + ~/.claude/effort-board/factory.config.json).
_sections: order: top to bottom. enabled: which show. open: which strips (jauge, usage, veille) start unfolded. breadcrumb = Méga › Projet › Conversation › Agent; tree = the clickable tree; diagram = the same tree drawn as an SVG (desktop only); detail = the selection's view (Mission at méga, Focus + Pipeline at projet, Arbre at conversation, agent card and log at agent); fichiers = a button that opens filetree's own tab.
_default_level: where the pane opens at session start: mega, macro (this conversation's project, the conversation selected) or medium (this conversation's Workflows and agents).
_auto_open: true: the pane opens by itself when a session starts (also needs userConfig start = on). It sits in the same right column as filetree, as a second tab: the desktop shows one pane at a time, the others as tabs.
_refresh: seconds; nothing is read while the pane is closed or another tab (filetree) is the one shown.
_colors: SVG colours (the drawing is an image: theme keys do not reach it). term_colors: theme keys for text.
